interaction.prompt: You just did a shoulder check coming through the neutral zone. Tap the teammate your scan revealed is open.

feedback.right: Your pre-receive scan paid off — the RW is completely unguarded on the far side. Hit them in stride for a clean zone entry.
feedback.wrong: The LW looks close, but a defender is already shadowing them in that lane. Your shoulder check should have spotted that coverage. The RW on the far side is wide open.

tip: Scan before the puck arrives, not after — that way you catch and release in one motion. The read is already done when the puck hits your stick.
why: Scanning before receiving turns a catch into a two-move play: the moment the puck arrives you already know where it's going, so there's no hesitation gap for defenders to close.
